title: Encode Once, Decode Never: Reusing Audio LM Internals for Efficient Temporal Localization
abstract: arXiv:2602.10230v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Audio language models process input audio into rich frame-level representations, but the standard approach to temporal localization generates timestamps as sequences of text tokens, which discards the frame-level representations in favor of autoregressive decoding. However, generating timestamps as tokens is slow and not parallelizable, and tends to hallucinate when producing timestamps outside the training distribution. We propose internal frame-level reuse, a method that trains audio LMs to reuse their own internal audio representations for temporal localization directly, bypassing token generation altogether. We introduce a lightweight prediction head trained via different frame-level objectives: a binary frame classifier and a novel inhomogeneous Poisson process (IHP) loss that models temporal event intensity. Across word localization, speaker diarization, and event localization tasks, our approach can achieve a >50x inference sp

translated_title: 一次编码，永不解码：复用音频语言模型内部表征实现高效时间定位
translated_abstract: 音频语言模型会将输入音频处理为丰富的帧级表征，但标准的时间定位方法是将时间戳作为文本token序列生成，这种方式丢弃了帧级表征而依赖自回归解码。然而，以token形式生成时间戳速度慢且无法并行化，并且在生成超出训练分布的时间戳时容易产生幻觉。我们提出内部帧级复用方法，训练音频语言模型直接复用其自身的内部音频表征来完成时间定位，完全绕过token生成过程。我们引入了一个轻量级预测头，通过不同的帧级目标进行训练：二元帧分类器以及一种新颖的、可建模时间事件强度的非齐次泊松过程（IHP）损失。在词定位、说话人分离和事件定位等任务上，我们的方法可以实现超过50倍的推理加速。
tldr: 提出内部帧级复用方法，让音频语言模型直接复用内部音频表征并通过轻量级预测头（帧分类器与非齐次泊松过程损失）进行时间定位，完全绕过token生成，在词定位、说话人分离和事件定位任务上实现超过50倍推理加速。
en_tdlr: Proposes internal frame-level reuse, enabling audio LMs to directly reuse their internal audio representations for temporal localization via lightweight prediction heads (frame classifier and inhomogeneous Poisson process loss), bypassing token generation and achieving >50x inference speedup across word localization, diarization, and event localization tasks.
